question: What auspicious matter concerning time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: A time reference is made to now.
The speaker wishes to hear something.
The object is the deception of time.
That deception is qualified as auspicious.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear about the auspicious deception of time.
uncertainties: The sense of auspicious deception is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear about the auspicious deception of time.
